brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.requirement: Closed electronics enclosure – all open faces capped and top/bottom covered
requirements.evidence: All 6 side faces have solid end caps, top and bottom have full covers; check_build reports no OPEN_CAP_FACE and meshClash clear

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent port installed so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 with stem hex-port-louvre installed in cell slot 0, BOM contains hex-port-louvre

requirements.requirement: Enclosed volume to house board (at least one hex cell with cover/cap enclosure)
requirements.evidence: Single full cell piece:0,0,0;full fully enclosed by 6 caps + top/bottom covers provides interior volume

finish.summary: Built closed single-cell enclosure (full hex base) with all faces capped and sealed top/bottom, fitted with hex-port-louvre vent to allow airflow while remaining closed.

parts.name: Port louvre
